enabled.description: Set to '1' to enable the init script, '0' to disable.

schedule.description: Set to '1' to enable advanced scheduling of BOINC processes; '0' for upstream default priority settings.

boinc_user.description: User account under which the BOINC core client runs.

boinc_dir.description: Data directory for the BOINC core client.

boinc_client.description: Path to the BOINC client binary used by the init script.

boinc_opts.description: Additional command-line options passed to the BOINC core client.

boinc_nice_client.description: Nice level for the BOINC core client process.

boinc_nice_app_default.description: Nice level for default (non-GPU) scientific applications.

boinc_ionice_client.description: ionice class for the BOINC core client (3 = idle).
